missing_serial_numbers.title: The Unique Smart API no longer returns serial numbers
missing_serial_numbers.description:
The Unique Smart API answers, but none of the softeners in its response has a serial number. Every device and entity of this integration is keyed by that number, so they stay unavailable until it is back.

This is most likely a change on the side of Unique, not a problem with your setup or API key. Nothing needs to be done here: this message disappears by itself once the API returns serial numbers again. If it stays, please open an issue with a debug log, so the integration can be adapted to the new response.
